methods.summary: Build mode: flat, drag, undo, refusal, paint, Buy hover/place/move/sell, picker. Diagnostic records: Facts in the editor log; no separate text file. `[build-shots] kit buy-1-catalogue controls=N unkitted=U grey=G` and `kit build-6-picker ... hue-gradient=true|false` count controls without a kit class and controls drawing a neutral grey (swatches excluded); `buy buy-1-catalogue cards=N visible=V clipped=C placeholders=P cube-pictures=Q` counts Buy cards fully inside the scroll view, cards with a clipped name, cards showing the placeholder icon, and model-less items still drawing a picture. Filename rules from client/Assets/Editor/BuildShots.cs: `build-1-flat.png, build-2-drawing.png, build-3-undo.png, build-4-refused.png, build-5-painted.png, build-6-picker.png, buy-1-catalogue.png, buy-2-placing.png, buy-3-refused.png, buy-4-moving.png, buy-5-sold.png`. Measured run time and observed filenames: pending coordinator capture.
methods.cmd: python3 tools/unity_slot.py shots -- "${UNITY:-/Applications/Unity/Hub/Editor/6000.7.0b4/Unity.app/Contents/MacOS/Unity}" -batchmode -projectPath client -executeMethod Lifesim.Editor.BuildShots.Run -buildShotsOut {out} -logFile client/Logs/build-shots.log

args.name: shots
args.about: Comma-separated name=category[:stage]; categories: looks, face, body, hair, outfit, traits; stages: day, evening, turned, named, family. Names must be unique. Example: body=body,face=face

args.name: size
args.about: Optional WIDTHxHEIGHT in positive pixels; CreatorShots default is 1600x900
